exposure: Type of provider staffing triage (midwives vs physicians)
cohort: 335 low-risk nulliparous women with a term, vertex fetus laboring in a community hospital
finding: Women admitted by midwives had lower odds of oxytocin augmentation, epidural use, and cesarean birth compared to those triaged by physicians.
mod_finding: Patients admitted by midwives had lower odds of cesarean birth compared with those triaged by physicians.
